AcceptSemanticInstallationOfferRequestDt.description: Explicitly accepts one previously returned installation offer.

offerId.description: Opaque offer identity; no artifact location is accepted.

The exact fingerprint being accepted; the server re-probes the host
and rejects the request if this no longer matches what is currently
presented (defense against confirming a stale or attacker-supplied
fingerprint).

ActionContextRequirementsDto.description: Predicates the backend re-validates before invoking an action (spec §18).

featureAvailable.description: Whether the action's feature is implemented yet.

requiresSelection.description: At least one entry must be selected.

requiresSingleSelection.description: Exactly one entry must be selected.

category.description: Grouping used by menus and the command palette.

contextRequirements.description: Predicates the backend re-validates before invoking this action.

defaultShortcuts.description: Default keyboard shortcuts, before user overrides.

source.description: Whether this is a core action or contributed by a plugin.

ActionInvocationContextDto.description:
Typed context supplied with an action invocation: the active pane, the
current selection, and the cursor entry (spec §18). The backend
re-validates `ActionContextRequirements` against this rather than trusting
the frontend's own advisory availability evaluation.

cursorEntryId.description: The entry under the keyboard cursor, if any.

paneId.description: The pane the action was invoked from, if any.

selectedEntryIds.description: Currently selected entries in that pane.

actionId.description: The invoked action's id, echoed back for convenience.

clipboardText.description:
Text a plugin action asked the host to write to the clipboard, e.g.
`sample.copyMarkdownPath` (spec §20). The caller performs the actual
OS/browser clipboard write; the backend only authorizes and
generates the content.

invoked.description: Whether the action ran (always `true` on a non-error response).

operationId.description: The operation started on behalf of this action, for mutating actions.

oneOf.description: Registered by the application itself.
Contributed by an enabled plugin.

pluginId.description:
The contributing plugin's stable id.

Explicit rename: utoipa's `ToSchema` derive does not honour the
container's `rename_all_fields`/`rename_all` for struct-like enum
variant fields, so without this the generated OpenAPI schema (and
the Orval client built from it) would advertise `plugin_id`
while the actual wire JSON (governed by serde) is `pluginId`.

ActionSourceDto.description: Whether an action is built in or contributed by a plugin (spec §18, §19).

ActivateLlmProfileRequestDto.description: Activation request carrying explicit informed cloud consent.

consent.description:
Whether the user consented to sending prompts and retrieved excerpts to
the profile's normalized cloud host.

ApplicationErrorCode.description:
A closed set of machine-readable error codes.

Codes are stable and additive: existing variants are never renamed or
removed, only appended to.

ApplicationErrorDto.description: A structured, user-facing error, never a raw OS error string (spec §8).

message.description: A user-readable description, never a raw OS error.

requestId.description: Correlates this error with the request that produced it.

example.message: A file named report.pdf already exists.

ApplicationUninstallCandidateDto.description:
One file or folder discovered under a well-known macOS location that
appears to belong to the application being uninstalled.

removable.description:
Whether this candidate can actually be moved to the Trash. `false`
for matches under `/Library`, which require elevation this feature
does not implement - such candidates are reported so the user can see
them, but must never be offered a way to remove them.

sizeBytes.description: Total size in bytes (recursive for a directory).

ApplySyncPlanRequestDto.description:
Applies a (possibly user-edited) sync plan
(`POST /api/v1/comparisons/{comparisonId}/apply-sync-plan`).

Every non-`skip` row starts one ordinary `copy` or (confirmed, permanent)
`delete` operation through the existing operation engine, with the
normal conflict, progress and cancellation semantics (spec §35: nothing
runs without this explicit, reviewed call).

items.description:
The (possibly edited) rows to apply. Rows with action `skip` start no
operation.

ApplySyncPlanResponseDto.description: The operations started by applying a sync plan.

operationIds.description:
One operation id per applied (non-`skip`) row, in the same order as
the request's `items`.

ArchiveCredentialRequestDto.description: Supplies a password for one archive to the current backend session.

location.description: Any location within the target archive; only the outer archive identity is cached.

password.description: Password to cache in backend memory. Transport adapters must not log request bodies.

ArchiveInfoDto.description: Archive-specific metadata for an entry (for example a `.zip` file).

compressedSize.description: The entry's compressed size within its archive, in bytes, when known.

compressionMethod.description: The compression method used for this entry, when known.

entryCount.description: Number of entries contained in the archive, when known.

uncompressedSize.description: Total uncompressed size in bytes, when known.

ArchiveSummaryRequestDto.description: Requests an archive's recursively computed summary for the F3 viewer (task 0141).

location.description: The outer local archive file; the application derives its `archive://...!/` root.

ArchiveSummaryResponseDto.description: Content-derived archive format and provider-neutral recursive entry totals.

compressedSize.description: Packed payload bytes when the format exposes them cheaply.

format.description: Canonical format label derived by the archive provider from content.

uncompressedSize.description: Sum of every file entry's uncompressed size.

BeginOneDriveAuthorizationResponseDto.description:
The outcome of beginning a OneDrive authorization attempt (task 0110,
`POST /api/v1/connections/{connectionId}/onedrive/authorize`): the caller
opens `authorization_url` in the system browser (the backend never opens
a browser or embedded webview itself) and polls `attempt_id` for
completion. Never carries a token - the authorization code/token exchange
happens entirely on the backend, asynchronously.

attemptId.description: Identifies this authorization attempt for later polling/cancellation.

authorizationUrl.description:
The Microsoft identity platform authorization URL to open in the
system browser.

CalculateFolderSizeRequestDto.description:
Requests a directory's recursive total size (`POST /api/v1/directories/size`), for the Total
Commander-style "press a key on a folder to see how much space it consumes" behaviour
(task 0071).

CalculateFolderSizeResponseDto.description: The recursive total size of a directory and how many files were counted.

totalBytes.description: Sum of every descendant file's (and unfollowed symlink's) size, in bytes.

CancelKnowledgeAnswerRequestDto.description: Requests cancellation of one running knowledge answer generation.

requestId.description: Identity supplied when generation was started.

CancelKnowledgeSearchRequestDto.description: Requests cancellation of one running knowledge search.

requestId.description: Identity supplied when the search was started.

CheckpointSemanticModelMigrationRequestD.description: Persists a resumable model migration checkpoint.

ChecksumAlgorithmDto.description: A checksum algorithm the backend can compute.

checksums.description: Digests keyed by lower-case algorithm name (`sha256`, `blake3`, …).

error.description: Why this entry could not be hashed, when it could not be.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the selection's common root.

ChecksumFileDto.description:
The rendered checksum-file text, for the caller to copy to the clipboard.

Rendering deliberately does not write anything. Writing the same text to
disk is a separate, explicit step — [`SaveChecksumFileRequestDto`] — which
goes through the provider's audited `WRITE` path, so there is no second,
unaudited way to create a file (spec §35).

ChecksumPageDto.description:
A bounded page of a checksum job's results
(`GET /api/v1/checksums/{jobId}`).

algorithms.description: Algorithms the job was started with.

hasMore.description: Whether another page exists, or more entries may still arrive.

isCancelled.description:
Whether the job stopped because it was cancelled. Distinguishes a
short result set that is final from one that simply did not finish.

isComplete.description: Whether the backend has stopped producing further entries.

jobId.description: The job this page belongs to.

limit.description: Requested page size after server-side clamping.

totalEntries.description: Entries the job was asked to hash.

ColumnConfigurationDto.description: Persisted width and visibility for a single directory-table column.

columnId.description: The column's identifier, e.g. `"core.name"` or a plugin-provided column.

visible.description: Whether the column is currently visible.

ComparisonCriteriaDto.description: How two directory trees are compared.

oneOf.description: Left-side metadata, absent when [`ComparisonStatusDto::OnlyRight`].

relativePath.description: Path relative to both roots, using `/` separators.

oneOf.description: Right-side metadata, absent when [`ComparisonStatusDto::OnlyLeft`].

status.description: The computed outcome for this path.

ComparisonEntrySideDto.description: One side's metadata for a compared entry.

contentHash.description: Streamed content hash, present only under content-hash criteria.

ComparisonPageDto.description:
A bounded, optionally differences-only page of a comparison's results

comparisonId.description: The comparison this page belongs to.

isComplete.description:
Whether the backend has stopped producing further entries (either

limit.description: Requested page size after server-side clamping.

offset.description: Requested zero-based offset, into the (possibly filtered) result set.

total.description: Number of entries matching the requested filter, known so far.

warningsCount.description: Cumulative count of unreadable directories skipped so far.

ConnectionDto.description:
A connection profile as returned by the API.

Structurally unable to carry a secret: `has_credential` is a presence
boolean only.

createdAt.description: When this connection was first created.

hasCredential.description:
Whether a credential is currently stored for this connection. Never
the credential itself or its reference.

lastError.description:
The dialer's failure message from the most recent `connect`/`test`
that ended in `status: "failed"` (task 0104) - `None` whenever
`status` is anything else, or the connection has never failed that
way. Never a secret: dialer failure messages are sanitized connection
diagnostics (unreachable host, rejected credential), not credential
material itself.

rootLocation.description:
The connection's browsable root `Location` URI (for example
`onedrive://<connection-id>/`), for providers where a saved
connection maps directly onto one navigable virtual root - task
0110's OneDrive accounts under the frontend's `CLOUD` favourites
group. Never a token, never a Graph/provider item id: purely the
connection id folded into that provider's location scheme, exactly
as `fm_domain::Location` already parses it. `None` for a kind with no
single meaningful navigation root (or none registered yet).

updatedAt.description: When this connection was last persisted.

oneOf.description: A plain password.
A private key, optionally protected by a passphrase.

A private key referenced by its filesystem path on the host running
the backend (the local machine for Tauri, or the fm-server host for
browser mode - always a local read, never sent from the browser),
read fresh from disk at dial time rather than stored at rest.

passphrase.description: Passphrase protecting the key file, if any.

path.description: Absolute or `~`-relative path to a PEM/OpenSSH private key file.

oneOf.description: An OAuth token pair.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token, if the provider issued one.

oneOf.description: An S3-style access key pair.

ConnectionSecretInputDto.description:
Write-only secret input accepted when creating or updating a connection
(spec §16 "Credential write requests must never echo secret values
back").

`Debug` is implemented by hand below and never prints secret content, so
this type stays safe even if a request is accidentally `{:?}`-logged
somewhere upstream of the handler that consumes it.

ConnectionStateDto.description: State of the SSE/event channel connection.

connected.description: Whether the connection is currently active

eventsReceived.description: Number of events received since last connection

lastEventReceived.description: Last timestamp an event was received (ISO 8601 format)

oneOf.description: New secret material to store, if this connection needs one.

tauriVersion.description: Tauri version if running in desktop mode

DirectorySnapshotDto.description: A batch of directory entries for one pane, at a specific revision.

continuationToken.description: An opaque token used to request the next page, when `hasMore`.

hasMore.description: Whether more entries remain to be paged in.

paneId.description: The pane this snapshot belongs to.

requestId.description: Correlates this snapshot with the request that produced it.

revision.description: Monotonic revision, used to reject responses to superseded requests.

totalKnownEntries.description: The total number of entries, when known in advance.

totalKnownFileCount.description:
The number of file/symlink entries in the directory (directories excluded), when known

totalKnownSize.description:

writable.description: Whether the current user may create entries in this directory.

foldersFirst.description: Whether directories are grouped before files.

sort.description: Replace the active sort descriptors, if present.

DiscoverApplicationUninstallCandidatesRe.description:
Requests discovery of a `.app` bundle's related files
(`POST /api/v1/applications/uninstall/discover`).

The result of scanning for an application's related files, for the user
to review before anything is deleted (task 0148). Nothing outside the
fixed set of well-known locations is ever touched, and nothing is
deleted by discovery itself.

bundleIdentifier.description: The bundle's `CFBundleIdentifier`, when its `Info.plist` declared one.

productName.description: The bundle's product name, shown in the review checklist.

relatedFiles.description: Related files discovered outside the bundle itself.

DocumentSummaryDto.description: Persisted generated summary with source-evidence identities.

profileId.description: Profile used to generate the prose.

sourceGeneration.description: Source generation represented by the prose.

stale.description: Whether the indexed source changed after generation.

supportingChunkIds.description: Extracted source chunks supporting this summary.

supportingWeights.description: Population weights aligned with supporting chunks.

DocumentSummaryPreviewDto.description:
Confirmation preview. Without a profile, passages remain local and are
deliberately labelled as key passages rather than a generated summary.

oneOf.description: Generation disclosure, absent in key-passages-only mode.

reusedSelection.description: Whether persisted support metadata was reused.

DocumentSummaryTargetDto.description: Exact file occurrence selected for summary operations.

workspaceId.description: Workspace through which the occurrence is authorized.

DocxPreviewResourceDto.description: One embedded image retained by a bounded DOCX preview session.

mediaType.description: Browser media type for the bounded image bytes.

resourceId.description: Opaque resource identifier scoped to the preview session.

source.description: Package-relative source used by the generated semantic HTML.

distinctLocations.description: Byte-identical files with distinct identities — the true duplicates.

fullHash.description: Full-content digest shared by every member.

hardlinkClusters.description:
Paths that are the same file through a hardlink. Presented separately

WorkspaceCommandDto.description:
A semantic workspace mutation (spec §5.3.9). Every variant carries the
`workspaceId` it targets and the `expectedRevision` it was issued
against, so the service can detect a stale-view conflict (spec §5.3.10)
before applying the mutation.

WorkspaceDto.description:
A workspace: a named collection of panes arranged in a
[`WorkspaceLayoutDto`].

activePaneId.description: The pane that currently has focus.

createdAt.description: When this workspace was first created.

ephemeral.description:
True for a per-window fork created for one desktop window's private use, false
for a named/template workspace that only changes when explicitly resynced.

Defaults to `false` when absent so workspace files persisted before this field
existed still deserialize.

forkedFrom.description: The named workspace this ephemeral workspace was forked from, if any.

layout.description: How the panes are arranged on screen.

name.description: A user-facing name for this workspace.

operationCentre.description: Operation-centre visibility and sizing preferences for this workspace.

panes.description: The panes making up this workspace.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision, used for optimistic conflict checks.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the persisted workspace schema, for migrations.

updatedAt.description: When this workspace was last persisted.

ratio.description: The fraction of space (0.0-1.0) given to `first`.

WorkspaceLayoutDto.description: How a workspace's panes are arranged on screen.

WorkspaceSummaryDto.description:
A lightweight projection of a stored workspace, cheap enough to list
without loading every pane and tab (spec §5.3.8, `GET /api/v1/workspaces`).

The conversion from `fm_application::workspace::WorkspaceSummary` lives in
`fm-application` (not here): that type is defined in a higher layer this
crate must never depend on, and Rust's orphan rules permit the impl to
live on either side as long as one of the two types is local to the
crate writing it.

ephemeral.description: True for a per-window fork, excluded from the workspace switcher.
